patterns: Separating UI data from AI data in TuViLogic
Injecting all 12 months transit into prompt regardless of view mode
Flattening star objects into formatted strings (e.g. `ĐV. Lộc Tồn [cat_tinh]`) drastically reduces prompt length while keeping meaning untouched for LLMs
gotchas: Deep cloning of CungInfo is required to prevent star accumulation during loops
Gemini prompt size increases significantly with 12-month JSON data
Trailing whitespace in names ('Nguyễn Thị Ngọc ') must be trimmed before injecting to prompt
Flags like Tuần/Triệt or markers like `[Cung Lưu Nguyệt]` shouldn't be parsed as stars, otherwise LLMs will hallucinate or read empty names
Inconsistent prefix formats (L., LN.) confuse LLMs—must unify using RegEx
